scope: One address for every independently named eddy label or named regional/family record currently admitted to the OSW almanac. This source-set inventory is not a complete global list of all eddies or all names. NOAA detection IDs are separate unnamed, dated observations.
identity_rule: Source records remain separate; possible Horizon/published matches are not verified identity joins.
release_scope: Full research candidate: 136 source identities. The separate rights-screened release excludes 96 Horizon registry labels.

No source-backed identity match to Astrid or Laura or to NASA's later model film is asserted.
